# David Ndungu — Get your AI-built software unstuck

Hands-on engineering for founders and small teams. Bring one stubborn bug, broken API/MCP integration or agent-generated change you need to ship. Work directly with David, a former Zendesk Staff engineer with 20+ years building software.

## When to use this service

An existing application has a reproducible issue, misleading passing tests, or a clearly defined integration that needs to work in the real workflow. Start with the failing behavior, your stack and your deadline.

## Find the blocker — $500 USD

One issue in one repository, up to four engineering hours, written findings, a walkthrough and a repair recommendation. Paid before the diagnostic. Target delivery is two business days after the agreed start and required access. This buys investigation, not a guaranteed fix.

## Get the change ready — $2,500 USD total

For a separately agreed fix or integration: implementation, regression checks and handoff, up to five business days from the agreed start. The $500 diagnostic is included. After diagnosis, $1,000 starts implementation and $1,000 is due when the written acceptance checks pass. Seven days of support for defects in delivered scope. Larger work and third-party costs require a separate agreement. No automatic upgrade.

Whole-app rewrites, open-ended feature development, security certification and emergency on-call support are excluded. Your team owns the repository, review and release decisions. Use your existing tools; no product subscription is required.

## Evidence and expectations

This is a new consulting offer without client case studies. Public projects and technical writing demonstrate David's own work, not customer outcomes. No guaranteed savings, autonomous delivery or immediate availability. Scope and start date are confirmed before payment.

## Contact

[Send David the problem](mailto:david@sire.run) or [book a free fit call](https://cal.com/david-ndungu/discovery). Include failing behavior, stack, deadline and how you found the site. The first call creates no payment or commitment.

[Ask David directly](https://ndungu.dev/#chat) by email or book a free fit call.
